notes: Beta: the running order is now built as the station plays rather than shuffled once at the start, so a song you've just downloaded can turn up next instead of waiting for the whole list to come round — and nothing gets stuck at the back. Listeners can ask for a song from a search box on your station's page (switch it on per station in Settings); a request is weighted heavily rather than shoved to the front, so it usually plays within a song or two but still arrives as part of the mix. Song titles now come from the music files themselves, so the punctuation and full credits that filenames had to drop come back. And the silence at the start and end of songs can be measured and skipped — Tools → Tidy up the gaps — which takes out a couple of seconds of dead air between tracks that otherwise sounds like the station stalled.
